dataset.name: OpenNeuro ds004666, sub-01/ses-2mm, AP 105-volume raw DWI and paired T1w
dataset.benchmark_input_condition: Same raw AP-DWI and original BIDS gradients; raw data were used because the provided processed DWI lacks paired eddy-rotated bvecs. This is an algorithmic same-input benchmark, not UKB-corrected-DWI performance.

run.freesurfer_status: Separate FreeSurfer reference not included in this report
run.atlas: SynthSeg-derived, 20 regions, exact same atlas NIfTI and affine for both arms
run.registration: Identity DWI-to-T1 RAS-world transform; shared T1/DWI world affine; SynthSeg foreground versus published DWI mask Dice 0.9513.
run.mrtrix_reference: Dhollander + MSMT-CSD lmax8 + mtnormalise + FSL 5TT ACT iFOD2 (-seed_gmwmi, -cutoff 0.1, -power 0.5, -samples 3) + tcksift2 + tck2connectome -symmetric -assignment_radial_search 4. FSL 5TT substitutes for original FreeSurfer+FIRST 5TT.
run.pytorch_candidate: PyTorch three-tissue response/CSD lmax4, discrete probabilistic tractography with GM/WM boundary seeds, approximate SIFT2, exact endpoint matrix assignment; TF32 enabled, float32 tensors.
run.controlled_seed_reference: Same MRtrix FOD and FSL 5TT, but -seed_image uses PyTorch binary WM/GM boundary mask instead of -seed_gmwmi. This alters one MRtrix input and is diagnostic only.
run.source_equivalence: Seven modules are byte-identical to the numeric run. pipeline.py differs only by removing its default n_seeds=10000000, making n_seeds required; all numeric runs supplied n_seeds=10000 explicitly. Computational code is unchanged.
run.atlas_identity_qc: All 3 PyTorch seeds: label voxel mismatches 0, affine max abs difference 0 versus MRtrix atlas (atlas_identity_qc.public.json).
run.seed_mask_qc: FSL 5TT GMWMI positive support versus PyTorch WM/GM binary boundary support Dice 0.4544 in DWI grid (seed_mask_qc.public.json).

runtime_wall_seconds.timing_scope: PyTorch times include input NIfTI loading, response/FOD, tracking, approximate SIFT2, matrix calculation and NIfTI/CSV output, using existing segmentation and identity transform. MRtrix stages are separate process wall times and reuse precomputed CSD and FSL 5TT; sum is not a matched full-pipeline speed comparison.
